title.value: Towards Painless Policy Optimization for Constrained MDPs
title.justification: The title of the paper is clearly mentioned at the beginning of the document.
title.quote: Towards Painless Policy Optimization for Constrained MDPs

extractions.description: This paper explores policy optimization in infinite horizon, γ-discounted constrained Markov decision processes (CMDPs). The focus is on finding policies that maximize expected reward while minimizing constraint violations, specifically in an online setting using linear function approximation. The authors propose a primal-dual framework and introduce the Coin Betting Politex (CBP) algorithm, which does not require extensive hyperparameter tuning and is robust in performance. Experiments on synthetic and Cartpole environments are conducted to demonstrate the efficacy of CBP.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The central theme of the paper is on optimizing policies in Constrained Markov Decision Processes. Although it mentions applications in various fields, including wireless sensor networks, which have climate-related impacts, the primary focus is on the mathematical and computational efficiency of CMDPs, not directly on sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Our objective is to return a policy that achieves large expected reward with a small constraint violation.

primary_category.justification: The primary focus of the paper is on the development and optimization of algorithms for CMDPs. It does not engage directly with any specific categories related to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development.
primary_category.quote: We study policy optimization in an infinite horizon, γ-discounted constrained Markov decision process (CMDP).

secondary_categories.justification: While the paper mentions applications that could align with climate-related topics (e.g., wireless sensor networks), these are not detailed or focused upon in the study, hence not serving as secondary categories for Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development.
secondary_categories.quote: However, many applications require the planning agent to satisfy constraints – for example, in wireless sensor networks...

applications.justification: The main application of the paper is to optimize algorithms used in CMDPs, particularly introducing the Coin Betting Politex (CBP) algorithm which aims to maximize rewards while minimizing constraint violations.
applications.quote: We propose a generic primal-dual framework that allows us to bound the reward sub-optimality and constraint violation for arbitrary algorithms...
